name: Market Street The Woodlands
summary: Trendy, mixed-use town center housing luxury retailers, upscale restaurants, bars & a movie theater.
demographics: Market Street The Woodlands attracts an affluent demographic from one of Texas's wealthiest master-planned communities, with visitors typically consisting of upper-middle to high-income households (median household income $120,000+), educated professionals aged 30-65, and families seeking premium lifestyle experiences. The trade area draws from The Woodlands' population of approximately 115,000 residents plus surrounding Montgomery County communities, characterized by high homeownership rates, dual-income families, and significant disposable income. Shoppers gravitate toward premium and luxury brands, value experiential retail and dining, and frequently visit for both planned shopping trips and spontaneous social outings in the center's resort-like atmosphere.
description: Market Street The Woodlands is a premier open-air lifestyle destination that redefines the traditional shopping experience in The Woodlands, Texas. Located at 9595 Six Pines Drive, this vibrant mixed-use center seamlessly blends upscale retail, dining, and lifestyle amenities in a walkable outdoor setting. The center features an impressive mix of high-quality tenants including Kendra Scott, Golden Goose, Pink Chicken, and Gorjana, offering everything from fashion and accessories to wellness and entertainment options. Beyond shopping, Market Street creates a true sense of community through year-round events including holiday entertainment, live music performances, and their annual Sing Off Competition. With onsite concierge services, premium parking, a Hyatt hotel, and their philanthropic Change for Charity program, Market Street The Woodlands delivers an elevated lifestyle experience that goes far beyond typical retail.
